svg.title: Attention in one picture
svg.desc: Each token vector is multiplied by three learned matrices to make queries, keys and values. Every query is compared with every key to give a grid of scores. Scores for future tokens are masked out. Softmax turns each row into weights that add up to 1, for example "artificial" puts 36 percent of its weight on "learning". Each token's output is the weighted mix of the value vectors.
svg.text: Compare, turn into weights, mix. Every token does this for every earlier token, all at once.
values are mixed by the weights
